surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012145715 ring (RD); ticket hall rectangle, eaves and ridge from the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof planes, wings as the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/amstelstation-prepare.ts).
